description: Records an evaluator decision on an open dispute and transitions the commitment to the canonical nonfinancial outcome (continue|rework|satisfied|against). The caller must present an EIP-712 authority proof and hold an unrevoked, unexpired EVALUATOR authorization on the commitment (verified in-transaction). Resolution NEVER executes a financial transfer or settlement. Idempotent per idempotencyRef.

agentId.description: The caller's agent identity (bound to the verified principal)

name: resolve_dispute
title: Resolve an open dispute
